value.answer: Honda Odyssey, I'd say. U.S. News has it top at 9.3/10, KBB has it first too, and it drives most like a car, with responsive steering and a smooth V6. The downside is front-wheel drive only and about 22 mpg combined. If fuel economy matters more to you, the Sienna hybrid gets 35–36 mpg combined.
